description: Builds a daily guitar practice routine and a 4-week focus plan sized to the player's level, the minutes they have each day and their goal (songs, strumming, fingerpicking, lead, barre chords, theory or general). Uses Fretwork's 10-stage curriculum, where stage 0 is for someone who has never played.

stage.description: Fretwork stage 0–9 (0 = never played, 1 = first chords, 2 = rhythm & songs, 3 = riffs & first solos, 4 = barre chords, 5 = scales & keys, 6 = lead guitar, 7–9 = advanced).

name: make_practice_plan
title: Make a guitar practice plan
